# Forgejo

Beyond coding. <span class="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-red-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent whitespace-nowrap"> We forge. </span>

<div style="grid-area: 1/2/5/3;">

<img src="/_astro/mascot-dark.1omhhgvT_1N84hK.webp" class="h-auto w-auto md:max-w-[125%] md:max-h-[calc(100%+20em)] mx-auto relative -mt-10 -z-10" loading="eager" decoding="async" width="1629" height="1273" />

</div>

<div class="text-justify md:text-left">

<span class="font-semibold">Forgejo</span> is a self-hosted lightweight software forge.  
Easy to install and low maintenance, it just does the job.

Brought to you by an inclusive community under the umbrella of <a href="https://docs.codeberg.org/getting-started/what-is-codeberg/#what-is-codeberg-e.v.%3F" class="hover:text-primary-600 hover:decoration-current transition ease-in duration-200 underline">Codeberg e.V.</a> , a democratic non-profit organization, Forgejo can be trusted to be exclusively Free Software. You can create an account on <a href="https://codeberg.org/" class="hover:text-primary-600 hover:decoration-current transition ease-in duration-200 underline">Codeberg</a> and <a href="https://codeberg.org/forgejo-contrib/delightful-forgejo#public-instances" class="hover:text-primary-600 hover:decoration-current transition ease-in duration-200 underline">other instances</a> or download it to self-host your own. It focuses on security, scaling, federation and privacy. Learn more about <a href="/compare/" class="hover:text-primary-600 hover:decoration-current transition ease-in duration-200 underline">how it compares with other forges</a> .

## Forge great software with Forgejo

Take back control of your software development process, self-host your projects and get everyone involved in delivering quality software on the same page.

</div>

<div class="grid mx-auto space-y-6 md:grid-cols-2 md:space-y-0 justify-center">

<div class="space-y-8 sm:px-8">

<div class="flex flex-row max-w-md">

<div class="mb-4 mr-5">

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="w-10 h-10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-500" />

</div>

<div>

### Simple software project management

**Ease of use** is important to get things done efficiently. Forgejo’s user experience is designed for **collaboration** and **productivity**.

</div>

</div>

<div class="flex flex-row max-w-md">

<div class="mb-4 mr-5">

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="w-10 h-10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-500" />

</div>

<div>

### Self-hosted alternative to GitHub

**Liberate your software** from proprietary shackles. Forgejo offers a familiar environment to GitHub users, allowing smooth transition to a **platform you own**.

</div>

</div>

<div class="flex flex-row max-w-md">

<div class="mb-4 mr-5">

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="w-10 h-10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-500" />

</div>

<div>

### Easy to install and maintain

Hosting your own software forge does not require expert skills. With Forgejo you can control your server with **minimal effort**.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="space-y-8 sm:px-8">

<div class="flex flex-row max-w-md">

<div class="mb-4 mr-5">

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="w-10 h-10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-500" />

</div>

<div>

### Lightweight and performant

With a **rich feature set**, Forgejo still has a **low server profile** and requires **an order of magnitude less resources** than other forges.

</div>

</div>

<div class="flex flex-row max-w-md">

<div class="mb-4 mr-5">

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="w-10 h-10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-500" />

</div>

<div>

### Guaranteed 100% Free Software

Forgejo will always be **Free and Open Source Software**. Furthermore we exclusively use Free Software for our own project development.

</div>

</div>

<div class="flex flex-row max-w-md">

<div class="mb-4 mr-5">

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="w-10 h-10 text-primary-600 dark:text-primary-500" />

</div>

<div>

### Beyond coding, we forge ahead

An exciting future awaits. We will innovate the Software Forge and enable **collaborative** software development facilitated by **decentralized** platforms.

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

</div>

## Get Involved

**Forgejo consists of motivated people, and we are looking forward to [your contribution](https://forgejo.org/docs/next/contributor/)** .  
Feel free to help in the domains of [localization](https://forgejo.org/docs/next/contributor/localization/), [code, federation, releases management](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues), [user research](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/user-research/), [UX and usability](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/design), [community management](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/code-of-conduct/issues), [documentation](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/docs/issues), [web design](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/website/issues), [governance](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/governance/issues) and more.
